input.text: Wir handeln oder Bürgerlichen Gesetzbuchs wegen fahrlässig.

_note: Without the \\b word-boundary guard on EVERY (?:der|des|dem) alternative in _EXT_DE_STATUTE (not only the fused-compound one), 'oder Bürgerlichen Gesetzbuchs' -- 'oder' ('or') ending in the substring 'der' -- could be misread as 'der Bürgerlichen Gesetzbuchs' (a real, adjective-qualified statute name) even though no genuine 'der/des/dem' article word is present.
